scheduling_metrics.pause_semantics: Other-request CPU preparation waits and prefill in the ready source. No new decode is submitted within these spans; an in-flight decode can overlap them. Not exclusive device stall time; do not add to device-stage or residency timings.
scheduling_metrics.occupancy_semantics: Launched counts include completion look-ahead. Consumed counts exclude stale slot epochs and count tokens before any final repetition trimming. Prefill's first token is not a decode iteration.
